result.description: A fictional 27-inch QHD productivity monitor built for quiet studio desks, writing, and color-sensitive everyday work. It features a matte IPS panel, 2560 x 1440 resolution, 100 Hz refresh rate, 350 nits typical brightness, and USB-C connectivity with 65W power delivery. The stand supports height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustments, while the slim bezels suit multi-display layouts.
